units.source_text: 薰君与匂亲王会面时，总是首先以宇治两女公子为话题。

en.t: Whenever Lord Kaoru met Prince Niou, he always began by speaking of the two young ladies of Uji.

units.source_text: 匂亲王以为现在八亲王已不在世，可以无所顾忌了，便竭诚地写信与两女公子。

en.t: Prince Niou thought that now Prince Hachi was no longer alive, there was nothing to hold him back, and he wrote devoted letters to the two young ladies.

units.source_text: 但两女公子计虑非常周到，一个字也不肯写回信给他。

en.t: But the two young ladies were extremely cautious and would not write even a single word in reply to him.

units.source_text: 她们想：“匂亲王非常好色，名闻于世。

en.t: They thought, Prince Niou is famously amorous, and his reputation is known throughout the world.

units.source_text: 他把我们看成了风流香艳的对手。

en.t: He sees us as elegant and alluring partners in romance.

units.source_text: 这人迹不到的蔓草荒烟之中写出去的回信，在他看来手笔何等幼稚而陈腐！”

en.t: If we sent a reply from this deserted place of tangled grasses and desolate mist, how childish and old-fashioned our handwriting would seem to him!

units.source_text: 她们怀着自卑之感，所以不肯写回信给他。

en.t: Because they felt so inferior, they refused to write back to him.

units.source_text: 原知人生如梦，但想不到悲哀之事立刻来到眼前。

en.t: We always knew that life was like a dream, but we never imagined that sorrow would come before our eyes so suddenly.

units.source_text: 我们日常听到又看到人世无常的事例，也知道此乃一般定理。

en.t: In daily life we heard and saw examples of the world's impermanence, and we knew this was the common law of things.

units.source_text: 然而只是茫然地想起人生总有一死，不过或迟或早而已。

en.t: Yet we only vaguely thought that everyone must die someday, the only difference being whether it came sooner or later.

units.source_text: 如今回思往昔，虽然生命全无保障，但一向悠闲地度送岁月，无忧无惧，平安无事地过了多年。

en.t: Now, looking back on the past, though life had never offered any guarantee, we spent the years at ease, free from worry or fear, and passed many years peacefully.

units.source_text: 而现在听到风声，亦觉凄厉可怕；

en.t: But now even the sound of the wind feels piercing and frightening.

units.source_text: 看到素不相识的人出入门庭，呼唤问讯，亦觉心惊肉跳。

en.t: When we see strangers coming and going at the gate, calling out and asking questions, our hearts tremble with fear.

units.source_text: 可怕可忧之事增添不少，实在不堪其苦。”

en.t: So many fearful and troubling things have increased that the suffering is truly unbearable.

units.source_text: 两人含愁度日，眼泪没有干时。

en.t: The two passed their days in sorrow, and there was never a time when their tears were dry.
Before they realized it, the end of the year had arrived.
